info.name: Finna API (Finland archives, libraries & museums)
info.description:
Finna.fi REST API: a read-only search over records from about 400 Finnish archives, libraries and museums, including the **National Archives of Finland (KA)**, the Finnish Heritage Agency and SLS. No key is needed and CORS is open.

Docs: https://api.finna.fi/swagger-ui/ · https://www.kiwi.fi/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=53839221 (terms of use apply)

query.description: relevance | main_date_str desc | main_date_str asc | title | author …

request.description: Main search across 20M+ records from Finnish archives, libraries and museums.

About 2.1 million archival descriptions from the National Archives of Finland (Kansallisarkisto): parish, estate, court, military and emigration-related material. Digitized church books themselves are at digi.kansallisarkisto.fi and astia.narc.fi.
Historic photographs, many free-licensed. Thumbnails display in the Visualizer.
Museovirasto: about 380k records, including historic photo archives.
SLS archives cover Swedish-speaking Finland: letters, folklore and family papers.
Counts only. Use the value codes in filter[].
Lists organisations whose names match a regex, e.g. local archives (arkisto) or museums (museo).
Get one record by its id from search results (web page: https://www.finna.fi/Record/{id}).
Returns the original source record (MARC, LIDO or EAD).
Name authority records: persons, families and corporate bodies.
Records in a public Finna list. The list id is in the list URL on finna.fi.
